Subject: Draft timing for upcoming stock plan grants - please review

Hi team,

I'm circulating a proposed timeline for the upcoming equity grant cycle so we can lock the board window and coordinate with our 409A effective date. Key notes in the attached equity-rollout-plan.pdf and the grant-timeline-matrix.xlsx:

- Target grant date (board-approved effective date): Friday, Aug 14, 2026
- 409A valuation effective date proposed: Aug 7, 2026 (to cover August grants)
- Offer holds / blackout: July 31 - Aug 16 (no late-cycle manual grants without exec sign-off)
- Plan reserve check: we have ~3.2% runway, recommend a 0.5% refresh for hiring needs

Action items:
1) Legal: confirm whether Aug 14 is fine from a board calendar / disclosure standpoint (Jonas / Fenwick)
2) Finance: confirm grant accounting and whether the 409A timing causes any reporting/tax frictions (Markus)
3) People/Talent: freeze rolling offers that expect grant prior to Aug 14 and push communication plan for new hires (Karthik/Laura)

Attachments: equity-rollout-plan.pdf (PDF), grant-timeline-matrix.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Monica

Monica — thanks for the clear plan. A few finance points after a quick pass:

- Aug 7 409A valuation is OK but we'd prefer Aug 6 close-of-business so CPAs can finalize reports before board packet (gives one business day buffer).
- We need to confirm the equity reserve bump with accounting: a 0.5% refresh looks fine operationally but will need board approval language in the packet.
- Implication for payroll/tax: for new hires with start dates in early Aug, advise delaying grant until after the board action to avoid corrective filings (suggest communicate to TA).

I'll loop legal for any language on the packet and will draft the balance sheet note.

-Markus

Folks — brief legal read:

- Board window Aug 14 is workable. We'll need the proposed resolution language and the plan amendment for the reserve before packet release. Fenwick can prepare the draft resolution and the short paper on tax/timing implications; they'll use the Aug 6 409A date that Markus recommended.
- For employees hired between Aug 1–Aug 13: best practice is to issue offer letters with standard equity language but include an explicit clause that grants will be issued following board approval (with illustrative grant amounts). That avoids immediate expectations and reduces admin corrections.
- If we anticipate any off-cycle discretionary grants during the blackout, require a written exec approval (email) specifying business reason and sign-off from CFO and Legal.

Attaching 409a-valuation-summary.pdf for reference — this is the draft we received from the valuation vendor.

-Jonas
